department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Round 1 scholarship applications close on 28 February 2027.
deadline.quote: *Please note: R1 Closing date for 2027 has been brought forward from 31 March to 28 February.

also.quote: Applications for admission can be submitted at any time throughout the year.

entry_route.value: Admission requires either a 4-year bachelor's degree with second class honours division A (H2A) or a master's degree with a research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year full-time study at H2A level.
entry_route.quote:
1.8 The minimum qualifications for admission into a doctoral course are:
1.8.1 a bachelor’s degree of at least four years in a relevant discipline, which includes a research thesis or project, with a minimum
overall average grade of an honours degree equivalent to the Second Class Honours Division A; or
1.8.2 a master's degree in a relevant discipline which includes a research thesis or project equivalent to at least 25 percent of one
year of full-time study, with a minimum overall average grade of honours equivalent to the Second Class Honours Division A;
or

supervisor.value: Admission is subject to the availability of appropriately qualified supervisors, and applicants must identify and contact a supervisor prior to applying.
supervisor.quote:
1.4 In addition to the eligibility requirements outlined at clauses 1.1 and 1.2, admission to a graduate research course is subject to the
availability of appropriately qualified supervisors with the necessary supervisory expertise and capacity, research facilities and other
resources required for the research project.

funding.value: Centrally managed scholarships for Australian campuses are awarded through a highly competitive process prioritised under RTP procedures.
funding.quote: Centrally managed scholarships for Australian campuses are awarded through a highly competitive process. The Graduate Research Committee prioritises applicants in accordance with the Research Training Program scholarship procedure.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Monash University offers the Doctor of Philosophy in Department of Materials Science and Engineering under centralized Graduate Research Admissions regulations.
